actual.origin_caveat: Analytical reconstruction at June27 using information throughOctober18, including subsequent guidance/commitments. This is not an origin-date backtest or an October18price target.
actual.units: USD millions; shares millions; per-share USD
actual.timing: H2FY2026stub then FY2027–2035; end-of-period discounting using actualdays/365.25; no already-earnedH1cashflow discounted again. FY2026full-year sales used only for growth/segment scale.

model_policy.ebit: Revenue and margins before customer-equity rebate claims; after recurring future employee grants, R&D, SG&A, recurring acquisition/support cost and explicit incremental lease rent. Acquired intangible amortization omitted; no corresponding amortization addback.
model_policy.employee_awards: Future grant cost is deducted once from operating profit and never added back. Model does not embed legacy recognition schedule, so no legacy expense reversal or PVasset. Old awards and ESPP only in an explicitly conditional claims bridge.
model_policy.capital: New capex cash paid contemporaneously, ordinary D&A added back once. Incremental NWC includes procurement/supplier prepayment needs and excludes capex financing. Fixed opening421settlement only inH2stub and neverinbridge. Purchase commitments fund modeled costs/workingcapital, not another debt subtraction.
model_policy.future_partner_investments: Separate gross funding and recoveries for up-to5bn commitments, selected100%callassumption; not an unconditional current debt. New asset returns excluded from EBIT; terminal recovered proceeds not also added as a bridge asset.
model_policy.leases: Existing rent remains in operating costs; forecast adds newlease rents. No operatinglease liability subtraction. More adverse unused-capacity/no-recovery cases use same or higher costs.
model_policy.terminal: Selected forward incremental return after expensed R&D and future grants. The reserve and terminal investment funding are jointly rebuilt in sensitivities; no measured capital-stock ROIC is claimed.
model_policy.reserve: Additional investment reserve is an analyst cash outflow for recurring acquisitions, non-R&D economic replacement and ecosystem growth capital beyond plant/NWC. It is not a reported forecast and does not recapitalize already-expensedR&D. Sensitivity required.
model_policy.tax: Normalized operating cash-taxassumptions; historicalGAAPtaxbenefits and investmentgains not extrapolated. OpeningUTBclaim is separate. No customer-warrant tax-credit assumed.
